explication: main.go et cli.go dispatchent les commandes, register.go cree le compte WARP, puis discovery.go parcourt les adresses de pools.go et les teste via warp.go, masque.go et tunnel.go. source: Claude, d'après l'arbre du dépôt et le README
explication_en: main.go and cli.go dispatch the commands, register.go creates the WARP account, then discovery.go walks the addresses from pools.go and tests them via warp.go, masque.go and tunnel.go. Exit nodes are located by geo.go, displayed in tui.go and written by report.go, with wgconf.go generating the importable configuration.
